source: Spec 124 R-DA (McDonald's Airtight V3): every entry is the measured PRE -> POST diff of docs/reports/golden/link_coa_to_parcels/{pre,post}/{coa,standalone}.json (Night P4 2026-10-20, lane night-p4-c, back-to-back under the dblock) or a #44 (g) PRE-trace read absent from POST, explained from the descriptor deviation, register rule or runner code it names. The table-state change is the first converted run's re-match (deviation 1); the R-EX rerun proof read zero writes after it.

diffs.why: PIPELINE_META is derived from the descriptor (Spec 122 §5.1): the converted step reads latitude, longitude and neighbourhood_id to decide a link change (scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 1 (Ruling 1, LCTP-D3/D6/D7, operator y 2026-10-18: every eligible CoA re-matched every run; departed pairs and vanished leads retracted; coa_applications written only for a CoA whose link changed): the back-fill writes only a CoA whose values move), so the list gains those three and each later position shifts; the legacy write-once filter's parcel_linked_at is still read.

The converted step reads its own coa: lead_parcels rows to diff the derived links against the stored ones (guarded upsert, keyed retraction of departed pairs, vanished-lead sweep, scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 1 (Ruling 1, LCTP-D3/D6/D7, operator y 2026-10-18: every eligible CoA re-matched every run; departed pairs and vanished leads retracted; coa_applications written only for a CoA whose link changed), Spec 124 R-EG); the legacy write-once upsert never read them.

The descriptor-derived write list orders the back-fill columns latitude, longitude, neighbourhood_id, parcel_linked_at (outputs.writes[2] declaration order); the legacy hand-written list put neighbourhood_id first. The same four columns are written.

scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 2-4: the legacy log lines (trade/logic-variable loads, PostGIS detection, the 158-neighbourhood Turf load, "Unprocessed CoAs to process", the per-row progress line, "Linking complete") retire with the write-once filter, the Turf path and the per-row loop; the runner prints its target line, the mode-gate line (full_rescan), the vanished-lead sweep line and the completion line.

scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 4 (LCTP-D8, the O1 fleet standard): audit_table.phase follows sharing.varies_by_chain.phase, the step's 1-based chain index 4, generated by scripts/generate-sharing-phase.js; the legacy literal was 42 (the Spec 42 number; 11 on its standalone NO_NEW_WORK lane).

scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 4 and the declared check set (descriptor checks[]): the runner adds links_retracted, coa_backfilled, the guards.empty_source row and one before_image_written:lead_parcels row per retracting batch (Spec 124 R-EG (5) before-image of every retracted pair, written under docs/reports/golden/link_coa_to_parcels/before-image/); the legacy per_row_errors, tier_1a_type_confirmed/tolerant, coa_parcels_linked_pct and unmatched_coa_count rows retire (scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 2, 4).

scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 4 and the declared check set (descriptor checks[]): coa_corpus_linked_pct is stated on its complement coa_corpus_unlinked_pct (a bound cannot be 100 - x), coa_parcels_linked_pct + unmatched_coa_count become one unmatched_coa_pct, the two bridge type counters and per_row_errors retire, so each later position names the next declared check.

Follows the metric reorder and scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 1 (Ruling 1, LCTP-D3/D6/D7, operator y 2026-10-18: every eligible CoA re-matched every run; departed pairs and vanished leads retracted; coa_applications written only for a CoA whose link changed): every eligible CoA is walked (coa_processed 17 -> 33857), so the corpus counts move (linked 30177 -> 31762, unlinked 3789 -> 2204: 1,585 CoAs the write-once legacy had stamped no-match now link) and each row carries its declared check's value.

The library renders the declared limit in force ("viol == 0", "pct <= 10", "pct >= 95", "pct <= 1") where the legacy printed its own literal strings (">= 90%", "<= 10%", "== 0") or null; the bounds are the step-owned variables of migration 272 (LCTP-D1).

Follows the reorder and the complement form: coa_corpus_linked_pct WARNed at 88.8% under the write-once legacy; coa_corpus_unlinked_pct reads 6.5% (PASS, pct <= 10) once every eligible CoA is re-matched (scripts/link-coa-to-parcels.descriptor.json deviations[] 1 (Ruling 1, LCTP-D3/D6/D7, operator y 2026-10-18: every eligible CoA re-matched every run; departed pairs and vanished leads retracted; coa_applications written only for a CoA whose link changed)). coa_corpus_missing_normalized_count stays the one WARN.
The library stamps every declared check row with source "check" (verdict.js checkRow); the legacy hand-built rows carried no source field.
The library stamps every declared check row with observed before_write / after_write (FLEET-2 lib #52); the legacy rows had no such field.
